title: The Fall of Jerusalem

questions.question: Who was made king after Josiah?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 36:1 (ESV): "The people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah and made him king..."

questions.question: Who deposed Jehoahaz and where was he taken?
options: The king of Egypt deposed him and took him to Egypt
questions.correctAnswer: The king of Egypt deposed him and took him to Egypt
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 36:3-4 (ESV): "...and Neco took Jehoahaz his brother and carried him to Egypt."

questions.question: Who made Jehoiakim king?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 36:4 (ESV): "The king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Judah... and changed his name to Jehoiakim."

questions.question: Who came up against Jehoiakim and bound him?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 36:6 (ESV): "Against him came up Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and bound him in chains..."

questions.question: How old was Jehoiachin when he began to reign?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 36:9 (ESV): "Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign..." (Note: some manuscripts say eight, but ESV says 18 here - wait, ESV text says 18. KJV/others sometimes say 8. Let's stick to typical translation or specify. Text says: "Jehoiachin was eighteen years old..." in ESV).

questions.question: Who was the last king of Judah?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 36:11 (ESV): "Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign..."

questions.question: Did Zedekiah humble himself before Jeremiah?
options: No, he stiffened his neck and hardened his heart
questions.correctAnswer: No, he stiffened his neck and hardened his heart
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 36:12-13 (ESV): "...He did not humble himself before Jeremiah... but he stiffened his neck..."

questions.question: What happened to the house of God?
options: They burned it and broke down the wall of Jerusalem
questions.correctAnswer: They burned it and broke down the wall of Jerusalem
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 36:19 (ESV): "And they burned the house of God and broke down the wall of Jerusalem..."

questions.question: How long did the land keep Sabbath?
Who made a proclamation to build the house of the LORD?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 36:22-23 (ESV): "...the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus... 'The LORD, the God of heaven... has charged me to build him a house...'"

questions.question: Why did God send messengers to them?
options: Because he had compassion on his people and on his dwelling place
questions.correctAnswer: Because he had compassion on his people and on his dwelling place
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 36:15 (ESV): "...because he had compassion on his people and on his dwelling place."

questions.question: How did they treat God's messengers?
options: They kept mocking the messengers of God, despising his words and scoffing at his prophets
questions.correctAnswer: They kept mocking the messengers of God, despising his words and scoffing at his prophets
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 36:16 (ESV): "But they kept mocking the messengers of God, despising his words and scoffing at his prophets..."

questions.question: Until when did the wrath of the LORD rise against his people?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 36:16 (ESV): "...until the wrath of the LORD rose against his people, until there was no remedy."

questions.question: What items were taken to Babylon?
options: All the vessels of the house of God, great and small, and the treasures
questions.correctAnswer: All the vessels of the house of God, great and small, and the treasures
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 36:18 (ESV): "And all the vessels of the house of God, great and small, and the treasures... all these he brought to Babylon."

questions.question: Whose word was fulfilled by the desolation of the land?
options: The word of the LORD by the mouth of Jeremiah
questions.correctAnswer: The word of the LORD by the mouth of Jeremiah
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 36:21 (ESV): "to fulfill the word of the LORD by the mouth of Jeremiah..."

key_verse_text: Thus says Cyrus king of Persia, “The LORD, the God of heaven, has given me all the kingdoms of the earth, and he has charged me to build him a house at Jerusalem, which is in Judah. Whoever is among you of all his people, may the LORD his God be with him. Let him go up.”
